import math
import unittest

from solution import suggest_items


class SuggestItemsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dot_products_ranking_stability_and_non_mutation(self):
        user = [2, -1, 0.5]
        items = [
            {"id": "a", "features": [3, 2, 0]},
            {"id": "b", "features": [1, -4, 0]},
            {"id": "c", "features": [3, 0, -4]},
            {"id": "d", "features": [0, 0, 2]},
        ]
        user_before = user[:]
        items_before = [{"id": item["id"], "features": item["features"][:]} for item in items]
        result = suggest_items(user, items, 3)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"id": "a", "score": 4.0},
            {"id": "b", "score": 6.0},
            {"id": "c", "score": 4.0},
        ][1:2] + [
            {"id": "a", "score": 4.0},
            {"id": "c", "score": 4.0},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(user, user_before)
        self.assertEqual(items, items_before)
        for returned in result:
            self.assertTrue(all(returned is not item for item in items))

    def test_known_dot_products_detect_addition_instead_of_multiplication(self):
        result = suggest_items(
            [2, 3],
            [
                {"id": "orthogonal", "features": [0, 5]},
                {"id": "negative", "features": [-4, 1]},
            ],
            2,
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"id": "orthogonal", "score": 15},
            {"id": "negative", "score": -5},
        ])

    def test_limit_boundaries_and_stable_ties(self):
        items = [
            {"id": "first", "features": [1]},
            {"id": "second", "features": [1.0]},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(suggest_items([2], items, 0), [])
        self.assertEqual(suggest_items([2], items, 10), [
            {"id": "first", "score": 2},
            {"id": "second", "score": 2.0},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(suggest_items([1], [], 5), [])

    def test_argument_and_field_type_errors(self):
        cases = [
            ((), [], 1),
            ([1], (), 1),
            ([1], [], True),
            ([1], [], 1.0),
            ([True], [], 1),
            ([1], [[]], 1),
            ([1], [{"id": 1, "features": [1]}], 1),
            ([1], [{"id": "x", "features": (1,)}], 1),
            ([1], [{"id": "x", "features": [False]}], 1),
        ]
        for user, items, limit in cases:
            with self.subTest(user=user, items=items, limit=limit):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    suggest_items(user, items, limit)

    def test_value_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([1], [], -1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([], [], 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([math.inf], [], 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([math.nan], [], 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([1], [{"id": "x", "features": [1], "extra": 2}], 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([1], [{"id": "", "features": [1]}], 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([1], [
                {"id": "x", "features": [1]},
                {"id": "x", "features": [2]},
            ], 2)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([1, 2], [{"id": "x", "features": [1]}], 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([1], [{"id": "x", "features": [math.inf]}], 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            suggest_items([1], [{"id": "x", "features": [math.nan]}], 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
